summary: Notice rich timestamps preserve exact RFC3339 wire spelling and share leap-second/microsecond conformance fixtures across Rust, Swift and Effect.

schema.detail: NoticeTimestamp opts into the generic lossless-timestamp rich codec; notice identifiers gain rich brands. Wire shapes are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Effect NoticeTimestamp decodes to wire plus an optional DateTime.Utc projection (None for leap seconds); encoding preserves spelling and precision. Existing timestamp codec APIs are unchanged. Notices remain internal models, not registered server resources.
